text:
Nova, a tiny orange fox, floated through space in her cream and sage spacesuit. Her mission: explore the cosmos! Suddenly, a colossal blue creature shimmered into view. It was Bloop, a friendly space whale, with eyes like swirling galaxies.

“Oh dear,” Bloop hummed, a sound like a distant, sad horn. “I’ve lost the last note of the Song of Starlight. Without it, the stars won’t glow tonight!”

Nova tilted her head, her ears twitching. She wanted to help! She took a deep breath and let out a tiny, enthusiastic “SQUEEEEEP!”

Bloop’s eyes widened. “That’s it!” he boomed, a joyful rumble. “The missing note! The final squeak!”

Immediately, a cascade of stars twinkled to life, painting the inky black with shimmering light. Nova giggled, her tail wagging.

Later, on a soft lavender moon, Nova and Bloop shared warm star cocoa, sipping it slowly under the newly lit sky.
